name: Manipulate - Wrath of the Razor Hound

system.notes: Entering a trance-like state and rubbing razor hound fur over their hands, a Goregon shaman can tap into the rage and sorrow of a Spartan Razor Hound that has lost its sibling. The shaman’s muscles ripple and bulge, tears flow freely from her eyes, and her hair stiffens and stands on end. While in this state, the shaman’s skill with a single weapon (usually the Goregon poleax, but some shamans favor other weapons) increases by +15.
